title: SEC filing: OpenAI invests ~$400M in its second startup fund, after it raised $175M for its first fund in 2021 from outside investors, including Microsoft (Sarah Klearman/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Sarah Klearman / Wall Street Journal: SEC filing: OpenAI invests ~$400M in its second startup fund, after it raised $175M for its first fund in 2021 from outside investors, including Microsoft — The ChatGPT maker is dedicating $400 million to investing in early-stage AI companies — OpenAI is launching a second startup fund …
contentText:
Sarah Klearman / Wall Street Journal :

SEC filing: OpenAI invests ~$400M in its second startup fund, after it raised $175M for its first fund in 2021 from outside investors, including Microsoft   —  The ChatGPT maker is dedicating $400 million to investing in early-stage AI companies  —  OpenAI is launching a second startup fund …
